files.purpose: Workflow-only script implementing CSPRNG seed generation, projection injection, deterministic validation against non-leaking salted commitment hashes, and zero-mutation on FAIL / atomic cleanup on PASS.
GitHub Actions workflow running seed injection on selector changes and deterministic validation and atomic cleanup on evidence submission, preventing infinite recursive commits.
files.content:
name: Truth Reader Verification

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'truth-reader/selector.json'
      - 'truth-reader/evidence.json'

jobs:
  truth-reader:
    # Prevent recursive workflow triggering when the workflow bot itself commits
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]' && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Determine Trigger Source
        id: trigger
        run: |
          CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
          if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -q "truth-reader/evidence.json"; then
            echo "mode=verify" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif echo "$CHANGED" | grep -q "truth-reader/selector.json"; then
            echo "mode=seed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "mode=noop" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Execute Seeding
        if: steps.trigger.outputs.mode == 'seed'
        run: node scripts/truth-reader-engine.js seed

      - name: Commit Seeded Projections and Challenge Commitment
        if: steps.trigger.outputs.mode == 'seed'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add reading-library/projections/ truth-reader/.state-commitment.json
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No seeded changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "chore(truth-reader): inject projection seeds [skip ci]"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}
          fi

      - name: Execute Deterministic Verification
        if: steps.trigger.outputs.mode == 'verify'
        run: node scripts/truth-reader-engine.js verify

      - name: Atomic PASS Cleanup Commit
        if: steps.trigger.outputs.mode == 'verify'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add reading-library/projections/ truth-reader/selector.json truth-reader/evidence.json truth-reader/status.json truth-reader/.state-commitment.json || true
          git commit -m "chore(truth-reader): atomic pass cleanup [skip ci]"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}
